typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Id as string,
		HomePhone as string,
		OtherPhone as string,
		Phone as string,
		MobilePhone as string,
		PTC__c as string,
		PTC_Scope__c as string,
		PTC_Source__c as string,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c as string,
		PTC_Expiration__c as string,
		Source as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/upsert_phone_preferences_*.csv']) ~> contactPTC
contactPTC select(mapColumn(
		Id,
		PTC__c,
		PTC_Scope__c,
		PTC_Source__c,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c,
		PTC_Expiration__c,
		Source
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
contactPTC select(mapColumn(
		Id,
		HomePhone,
		OtherPhone,
		Phone,
		MobilePhone
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Select2 unpivot(output(
		Phone_Type as string,
		Phone_Number__c as string
	),
	ungroupBy(Id),
	lateral: true,
	ignoreNullPivots: true) ~> Unpivot1
Unpivot1, Select1 join(Unpivot1@Id == Select1@Id,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join1
Join1 select(mapColumn(
		Id = Unpivot1@Id,
		Phone_Type,
		Phone_Number__c,
		PTC__c,
		PTC_Scope__c,
		PTC_Source__c,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c,
		PTC_Expiration__c,
		Source
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select3
Select3 derive(Type__c = case(Phone_Type == 'HomePhone', 'LandLine', Phone_Type == 'Phone', 'Work', Phone_Type == 'MobilePhone', 'Mobile', Phone_Type == 'OtherPhone', 'OtherPhone'),
		Active__c = true(),
		Contact__c = iif(Source == 'Contact', Id, toString(null())),
		Lead__c = iif(Source == 'Lead', Id, toString(null()))) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 derive(Name = concat(Type__c, 'Preference'),
		Unique_Id__c = concat(Phone_Number__c, Id, Type__c)) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ptc_Phone_Preferences__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		Phone_Number__c,
		PTC__c,
		PTC_Scope__c,
		PTC_Source__c,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c,
		PTC_Expiration__c,
		Type__c,
		Active__c,
		Contact__c,
		Lead__c,
		Name,
		Unique_Id__c
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
